description: Finds railway stations by name or public code among every station a stored train calls at, on every network GADUIN reads, whether or not it has a page on gaduin.com: name, public code (null where the railway has only an internal identifier: then pass the name with network to get_station_board), network, country, coordinates, time zone and how it matched. Matches rank by public code (or the railway's own station number), whole name, start of name, then any part of it; accents and case are ignored. total counts every match; returned is how many this answer holds, the first limit of them. coverage_days: the catalogue holds every station a train scheduled from that many days ago onward calls at.

limit.description: Max stations to return (1-50). Defaults to 20.

network.description: The railway's country code to narrow the match, e.g. GB, US or CH.

q.description: Station name, part of it, or its code, e.g. Zurich.

name: search_stations
title: Search railway stations
